The response provides a working median-finding algorithm, but it does not satisfy the stated O(1) space requirement. Python slicing (`nums1[i:]`, `nums2[j:]`) creates new lists, and recursion uses stack space, so the solution is not O(1) space. The explanation also incorrectly claims O(1) space and a single-pass O(n) time. While the core divide-and-conquer idea is correct, it does not meet the requested constraints.

Rating: [[4]]
